“Mmmm … I see darkness, darkness. Oh! A foul creature lurks, 
holding a basket. A door opens ... something shiny glows. I see 
your face trembling in the darkness, and below ... I see… “ She 
stops abruptly. “I can see no more.” She falls silent. 
Do you want to press her for more visions? If so, go to 378; 
or to return to Fuzira Marketplace, go to 134.
(318)
